**🐛 Bug Fix**

Thanks for fixing my mediocre code! I'm just an unemployed noob dev, so bugs are my specialty :D

### What bug did you fix?
- [ ] Wrong game info or NSFW/safety flag (usually easier as a Bug Report issue — please don't hand-edit `data_game/`, the pipeline writes it)
- [ ] Scraping failure (itch.io changed HTML again)
- [ ] Data pipeline / GitHub Actions fail
- [ ] Website bug (`webapp/src/`)
- [ ] Worker bug (`webapp/worker/` — image proxy, Suggest API, admin API)
- [ ] Desktop/Android app (Tauri) bug
- [ ] Other (describe below)

### Description
Explain the bug and how your fix works. Bonus points if you tested locally!

### Related Issues
Closes # (link issue number if any)

### Checklist
- [ ] Tested locally — Python: `pytest`, `ruff check scripts tests webapp/scripts`, `python scripts/validate.py`; webapp: `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npx tsc -b`
- [ ] No new bugs introduced (hopefully)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under the MIT License (see `LICENSE`)
- [ ] Followed the vibe (chill, no drama)
